label: Trolley pilot: principles against the triad and loop, and senses of wholly good for Rowe
summary: Typed trolley frame (causal graphs, death counts, plans, object classification) with six principles as Lean definitions; every verdict is computed by reachability. Lives-only act consequentialism is excluded by the footbridge/transplant verdicts (one formal case, two labels) and the KILLS_1 no-killing deontology by the switch verdict; the stipulated KILLS_2 reading escapes. Double effect on its causal and on its intention reading of condition 3, the causal MEANS_1 principle and a Thomson-style redirection principle each entail the common triad and are jointly satisfiable with all case facts. They split on the loop, a malicious switcher, closeness and an evil object, where no verdict's warrant is assessed, so they stand at parity. Loop: the causal reading and the means principle forbid it through condition 3 (MEANS_1), not intention; the intention reading permits it only on Kamm's plan reading and then needs a closeness criterion; redirection permits it on causal structure. Rowe: with the comparison Better free, WHOLLY_GOOD_1 plus the outcome bridge only relocates STMT-ROWE-PERMISSION-CONSTRAINT (bundle equivalent to a strengthened constraint, control 6; recorded as near-transcription, closure unchanged); WHOLLY_GOOD_2 relocates a constraint-qualified condition, and Rowe's argument survives wherever a constraint-free prevention exists; the WHOLLY_GOOD_3 model is a structural surrogate that omits the classical permission rule. Revised after the independent semantic challenge (6 P1, 11 P2 addressed). Details in docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
blocker: Verdicts remain prima facie premises; their degree of sharing, debunking evidence, loop survey data and Thomson's later rejection of the switch verdict are unread. Better has no typed content; the classical permission rule (ST I q.2 a.3 ad 1) is not yet encoded on Rowe's signature. Transfer from human intervening to divine permitting is owned by #1456 and the bearer bridge by #1735. The frame does not separate footbridge from transplant, has no separate impact event, and fixes condition 1 by stipulation.
